questions.target: 工资涨幅 vs 福利形式
questions.q: The hospital increased nurses' basic pay by only 1%, but expanded subsidized childcare and doubled its contribution to their retirement accounts. Which conclusion is best supported?
o: The package improved mainly because basic salaries doubled.
The package replaced childcare support with a rise in salary.
The package improved through benefits as well as basic pay.
The package funded higher pay by reducing pension support.

exp.trans: 医院只把护士的基本工资提高了1%，却扩大了托育补贴，并将其养老金账户的雇主缴费翻倍。合理结论是报酬待遇部分通过工资以外的福利改善。
exp.structure: The hospital + increased + basic pay ... but expanded ... and doubled ...；but对照基本工资小幅增长和两种福利的明显增加，结论应兼顾两边。
exp.other: subsidized childcare 托育补贴；contribution 缴费、投入；retirement account 退休金账户；reward package 总体报酬待遇。
exp.meaning: basic pay / cash salary与benefits / pensions不能混为一谈。工资表面增幅modest并不排除实际待遇因非工资福利而indirectly augmented。
exp.rest: 基本工资只涨1%，不是翻倍；托育补助扩大而非被替代；退休账户缴款翻倍，不能说削减养老金资助工资。

questions.target: 个人估计 vs 集体验证
questions.skill: 区分主张起点和取得认可所需条件
questions.q: An analyst estimates that the city has room for 4,000 people in emergency shelters. Officials will use this figure for evacuation plans only after independent teams verify the counts and agree on a common estimate. What makes the figure suitable for official planning?
o: The analyst's personal familiarity with the shelters.
Verification and agreement across independent teams.
The public release of a large numerical estimate.
The analyst's decision to avoid revising the original number.

exp.trans: 一位分析员估计城市应急避难所可容纳4000人；只有独立团队核查数据并就统一估计达成一致，政府才会在疏散计划中采用这一数字。
exp.structure: An analyst + estimates + that从句提出最初主张；Officials + will use + this figure ... only after ...，only after指出主张转化为官方依据所需的条件。
exp.other: emergency shelter 应急避难所；evacuation 疏散；estimate 估计；verify 核验。
exp.meaning: 题干问的是让一项初步主张获得认可所需要的机制。个人估计是起点，独立团队核查与达成一致是条件；不能因为看到analyst就选个人经验。
exp.rest: 个人熟悉情况只能解释估计如何产生；数字公开和规模大都不能自动证明可靠；拒绝修订反而与核查机制相冲突。

questions.q: A passage first notes that friends strongly influence exercise habits. In its final paragraph, however, it says a city program that deliberately groups inactive residents with athletes 'rarely produces lasting change.' What does the final paragraph suggest about the program's use of peer influence?
o: Its effect is uncertain or doubtful.
Its influence on behavior is necessarily profound.
It is clearly harmful to friendship networks.
It succeeds because peer influence is strong.

exp.trans: 文章先承认朋友会强烈影响锻炼习惯；但末段说，城市刻意把不运动者与运动者配组的项目很少产生持久变化。因此，项目利用同伴影响的成效值得怀疑。
exp.structure: first notes...给背景；In its final paragraph, however锁定观点转折；a city program是末段被评价对象，rarely produces lasting change是评价核心。
exp.other: deliberately 刻意地；inactive 不活跃的；lasting 持久的；peer influence 同伴影响。
exp.meaning: 不要把前文对自然影响力的强度评价，直接搬到末段对政策/项目有效性的评价。
exp.rest: “necessarily profound”把“同伴影响本身强”偷换成“这个项目效果深远”；“clearly harmful”加入原文没有的危害判断；“it succeeds”又与rarely produces lasting change相反。

questions.q:
The plumber thanked the neighbour. He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour.
哪句合并正确？
o: The plumber thanked the neighbour from that he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom from he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from him.

exp.trans: 水管工感谢了那位借梯子给他的邻居。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour. → 用whom替代重复的the neighbour：the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from → 把from前置：the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder。外层主干是The plumber + thanked + the neighbour，后接修饰neighbour的定语从句。
exp.other: plumber 水管工；neighbour 邻居；ladder 梯子；borrow A from B 从B那里借来A。
exp.meaning: from不是临时猜出来的，来自原句borrow...from...；先行词是人，介词后用whom。
exp.rest: from that：关系代词that不能直接置于介词后。whom from he：介词前置时必须是from whom，不是whom from。from him：关系代词whom已经代替该人，再保留him造成重复。

questions.target: 比较级推断 / 近期预测可能更难
questions.q: A transport planner finds it easier to sketch cities in 2300 than to forecast next year's commuting habits. Near-term forecasts depend on changing regulations, battery prices, and commuter choices. What is best supported?
o: Long-range city life can be predicted precisely from current data.
The near future may be harder to forecast than a distant future.
Commuting habits will certainly remain unchanged next year.
Long-term planning is never useful.

exp.trans: 交通规划者发现，勾勒2300年的城市图景，比预测明年的通勤习惯更容易。近期预测取决于不断变化的法规、电池价格和通勤者选择。
exp.structure: finds it easier to A than to B建立比较关系；第二句解释近期预测为什么复杂。
exp.other: forecast 预测；commuting habits 通勤习惯；regulation 法规；commuter 通勤者。
exp.meaning: easier to think about A than B支持B相对更难设想；这不等于B绝对无法预测，而是近期细节可能比遥远未来的宽泛图景更难预测。
exp.rest: 精确预测2300年超出easier的证据；明年习惯一定不变与快速变化的条件冲突；放弃长期规划也未被建议。

questions.q: The frightened child ___ tightly to his father's arm as the boat lurched through rough water; when the boat reached the dock, he did not try to ___ over the safety barrier.
o: climbed / cling
clung / climb
clung / climbed
climbed / climb

exp.trans: 船在颠簸水面上摇晃时，受惊的孩子紧紧抓住父亲的手臂；船靠岸后，他没有试图翻过安全护栏。
exp.structure: 第一分句：The frightened child + clung tightly to + his father's arm，tightly修饰clung。第二分句：he + did not try + to climb over + the safety barrier。clung是cling的过去式；climb是不定式原形。
exp.other: frightened 害怕的；tightly 紧紧地；lurch 突然摇晃；rough water 颠簸的水面；reach the dock 到达码头；safety barrier 安全护栏。
exp.meaning: cling to = 紧抓不放；climb over = 翻越/爬过。两个词形相近，但动作和搭配不同。
exp.rest: climbed tightly to his father's arm不符合“紧抓手臂”的语义和搭配；try to climbed over把过去式误放在不定式to后；climbed / climb的第二空虽可成立，但第一空仍不对；cling over不符合固定搭配。只有clung / climb同时满足两处语法和语义。

questions.target: 措施与结果的对应关系
questions.skill: 措施与结果的对应关系
questions.q: By accepting a single signed form, the club allows volunteers to avoid requesting a separate signature for every shift. Which benefit is described?
o: Volunteers may work extra shifts without signing any form.
Volunteers need not seek another signature for each shift.
Supervisors supply more signatures for every new volunteer.
Only supervisors may change the shifts a volunteer accepts.

exp.trans: 俱乐部接受一份签好字的表格，从而使志愿者不必每个班次都另外请求签字。好处是省去反复请求签字的手续。
exp.structure: By accepting...说明俱乐部采取的措施；allows的宾语是volunteers；to avoid requesting...说明志愿者由此免于什么行为。separate signature是被省去的逐班次手续。
exp.other: shift 班次；signature 签字；avoid doing 避免做、不必做；single 单份的。
exp.meaning: 使某人免于寻找或请求某物，不等于给他更多该物。先列措施、受益主体、被省去的行为和结果，再检查选项有没有改成增加数量或扩大资格。
exp.rest: 原文仍有一份已签字表格，不能说完全无须签字或允许多工作班次；也未说主管供应更多签字；变更班次的权限没有提及。

questions.skill: 过程承接 + This lack of coordination
questions.q:
前文：The regional train and bus operators publish separate schedules. Passengers often miss a connection when one service runs late.
【空缺】
后文：This lack of coordination persuaded the council to introduce a common timetable.
哪一句最自然？
o: The operators bought more comfortable seats for several long-distance services.
Mobile apps help tourists discover nearby restaurants and shops.
Neither operator adjusts its departure times when the other's service is delayed.
The council's new office opened beside the railway station last summer.

exp.trans: 前文指出火车和公交时刻表各自独立，乘客因此误车；正确句补充双方遇到延误也不调整衔接班次；后文的this lack of coordination便有明确指代对象。
exp.structure: Neither operator是主语，adjusts是谓语；when从句补充触发条件。后文This lack of coordination概括了这种双方未协调的行为。
exp.other: timetable 时刻表；connection 换乘衔接；departure time 发车时间；adjust 调整。
exp.meaning: 这种题不是谁的主题词多谁正确，而是候选句是否构成后文this/these抽象名词可总结的具体事实，并与前文的矛盾同向。
exp.rest: 座椅改善和附近商店虽与交通有关，却无法解释协调缺失；办公室搬迁也不构成换乘失误的直接原因。

compensation-components.target: 公开工资表 vs 延后福利
compensation-components.q: A port authority's new contract capped immediate wage increases at 2%. Negotiators nevertheless won additional paid leave and retirement payments that workers would receive years later. Why might the published wage table understate the agreement's value?
o: Because future benefits add compensation not visible in current wage increases.
Because the wage table proves that workers lost all holiday entitlement.
Because capped wages show that pensions must have been reduced.
Because only the highest-paid managers can receive retirement benefits.

exp.trans: 港务局新合同将近期工资涨幅限制在2%，但谈判代表争取到更多带薪休假和多年后领取的退休福利。因此只看当前工资表，会低估协议的总体价值。
exp.structure: A port authority's contract + capped + wage increases；Negotiators + won + leave and payments；years later修饰后续领取时间。Why题要解释工资表遗漏了哪一部分。
exp.other: cap 限定上限；port authority 港务局；negotiator 谈判代表；paid leave 带薪休假。
exp.meaning: backloaded compensation指把部分报酬安排在之后或以福利形式提供。不能把工资涨幅不大误读为整体待遇没有提高，更不能凭空判定增长‘过度’。
exp.rest: 原文明确增加假期而非失去假期；养老金被削减与additional retirement payments相反；限定只给高管没有证据。

process-stage-role.skill: 区分结果核验、消息公开与实施授权
process-stage-role.q: A hospital trial finds that a scheduling tool reduces missed appointments. The methods panel accepts the results after checking the analysis, and a staff newsletter reports the trial. Routine use must nevertheless wait for the operations board to approve a staffing plan. Which event authorises the hospital to start using the tool routinely?
o: Acceptance of the trial analysis by the methods panel.
Publication of the trial results in the staff newsletter.
The operations board's approval of the staffing plan.
The trial team's observation of fewer missed appointments.

exp.trans: 一家医院的试验发现，一种预约安排工具减少了爽约。方法审核小组检查分析后认可了结果，员工通讯也报道了这项试验。不过，常规使用仍须等待运营委员会批准人员配置计划。哪个事件授权医院开始常规使用该工具？答案是人员配置计划获批。
exp.structure: A hospital trial + finds + that从句给出试验发现；The methods panel + accepts + the results说明核验阶段。Routine use + must wait + for the operations board to approve a staffing plan说明实施仍受另一项决定约束。nevertheless连接结果已获认可与尚不能常规实施的转折。
exp.other: scheduling tool 预约安排工具；miss an appointment 爽约；methods panel 方法审核小组；staffing plan 人员配置计划；authorise 授权。
exp.meaning: 题目问开始常规实施的授权条件。独立核查在本文确实发生，却只让研究结果获得认可，不能替代运营委员会的实施批准。不能把所有过程题都机械答成独立验证。
exp.rest: 审核小组认可的是试验分析，不是常规使用的授权；员工通讯负责传播消息，没有审批权；试验团队观察到效果是提出采用建议的证据起点，仍未满足文中保留的实施条件。

process-stage-role.skill: 按提问定位过程中的决定而非总选最后一步
process-stage-role.q: A technician noticed an unusual label on a food shipment and asked a supervisor whether it should be checked. The supervisor marked the shipment 'hold', stopping dispatch. A laboratory later found the contents safe, and the quality manager signed the release form. Which event directly stopped the shipment from leaving?
o: The technician's request for advice about the label.
The supervisor's decision to put the shipment on hold.
The laboratory's conclusion that the contents were safe.
The quality manager's signature on the release form.

exp.trans: 技术员发现一批食品的标签异常，询问主管是否应检查。主管将这批货标为暂扣，停止发运。实验室后来确认货物内容安全，质量经理签署了放行单。哪个事件直接阻止了货物运出？是主管作出的暂扣决定。
exp.structure: The technician + noticed ... and asked ...是发现和上报；whether it should be checked是询问内容，其中should be checked为被动谓语。The supervisor + marked + the shipment + hold，后接stopping dispatch说明结果。found the contents safe为find加宾语和形容词补语；signed the release form属于后来的放行阶段。
exp.other: shipment 一批货物；put on hold 暂停、暂扣；dispatch 发运；release form 放行单；contents 所装物品。
exp.meaning: 先确定题目问的是停止发运，而非最早发现异常、确认安全或最终放行。直接产生停运结果的是主管的暂扣决定。过程角色题必须按问题定位阶段，不能一概选最后的正式批准。
exp.rest: 技术员询问是否检查，是上报起点，文中实际停运由主管决定；实验室认定安全发生在之后，支持解除疑虑；经理签放行单允许后续运出，与停止运出方向相反。

paragraph-scope-attitude.target: 段落限定 / 一般影响 vs 人为干预成效
paragraph-scope-attitude.q: One paragraph says recommendation algorithms exert enormous influence on what users click. The last paragraph says attempts by regulators to steer those algorithms through a simple disclosure rule are 'far less certain' to work. If a question asks about the effect of the intervention in the last paragraph, which description fits best?
o: profound
uncertain
desirable
harmless

exp.trans: 前一段说推荐算法对点击行为影响很大；最后一段却说监管者仅靠披露规则来引导算法是否有效，远没有那么确定。若题干限定最后一段的人为干预，其成效应是“存疑的”。
exp.structure: 第一句评价algorithm influence；第二句把对象切到attempts by regulators，并用far less certain限定能否奏效。
exp.other: intervention 干预；regulator 监管者；disclosure 披露；steer 引导。
exp.meaning: “影响本身很强”不等于“人为操控这种影响的策略有效”。题干有in the last paragraph时，必须服从局部段落的评价对象。
exp.rest: profound对应前段影响巨大，不能移作末段干预效果；desirable评价是否值得期待，harmless评价有无伤害，均不是far less certain表达的成效存疑。

paragraph-scope-attitude.skill: 段落限定与转折作用范围
paragraph-scope-attitude.q:
[Paragraph 2] Hidden delivery charges stop buyers from comparing full prices.
[Paragraph 3] Sellers should show all charges before payment, though small shops could have a short transition period.
[Paragraph 4] But a shared billing platform would take years to build; simple cost tables can be used first.
Which concern is expressed in Paragraphs 2 and 3?
o: Buyers cannot readily compare the total prices.
Small shops will have to stop selling online.
A shared billing platform faces a lengthy delay.
All delivery charges should be removed now.

exp.trans: 第2段说隐藏配送费妨碍买家比较总价；第3段要求付款前披露所有费用，但小商家可有短暂过渡期；第4段转谈统一计费平台耗时，可先用简单费用表。题干问第2、3段的关切，是总价难以比较。
exp.structure: 第2段Hidden delivery charges是主语，stop是谓语，buyers是宾语，from comparing...表示被阻碍的动作。第3段though引出执行时间上的让步；第4段But引出实施工具的困难与替代办法，不能自动改写前两段的问题。
exp.other: delivery charge配送费；transition period过渡期；billing计费；cost table费用表。
exp.meaning: 先按题干限定取证，再判断转折连接的具体命题。后文But不天然比指定段落更有权重；局部过渡安排也不推翻披露总价的原则。
exp.rest: “小店将停止网售”没有证据；“统一平台建设耗时”是第4段的信息，超出题干要求的段落；“立即取消全部配送费”把披露费用换成取消费用。

relative.q:
The archive contains several letters. The historian based her argument on those letters.
最自然的合并是：
o: The archive contains several letters on which the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which on the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters on that the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which the historian based her argument on them.

diag.1: 介词 on 应放在关系代词 which 前，不能写 which on the historian...
diag.2: 介词后不能用关系代词 that；应使用 which。
diag.3: which 已经代替 those letters，后面再用 them 造成重复。

exp.trans: 这个档案馆收藏着几封信，历史学家正是依据这些信件提出了她的论证。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：The historian based her argument on those letters. → those letters 变成先行词 several letters，并用 which 代替：the letters which the historian based her argument on → 正式写法把介词前置：the letters on which the historian based her argument。
exp.other: archive 档案馆；historian 历史学家；base A on B 以B为依据建立A；argument 论证/观点。
exp.meaning: 介词 + which 用于物；介词来自原简单句中的搭配 base A on B。
exp.rest: 介词前置的正确句是 “letters on which ...”；把 which 放在 on 前、把 that 放在介词后，或在 which 后再保留 them，都会造成词序或关系词重复问题。

text3-comparison-inference.skill: 比较关系支持相对难度推断
text3-comparison-inference.q: Researchers can outline broad possibilities for energy use in 2200, yet cannot confidently predict household electricity bills next winter because fuel prices, weather, and policy may shift quickly. Which inference follows?
o: Next winter's events resist any kind of prediction or planning.
Distant energy scenarios can be predicted without uncertainty.
Near-term details may be harder to predict than distant scenarios.
Weather and policy have little relevance to household energy costs.

exp.trans: 研究者可以概述2200年能源使用的几种大致可能性，却无法有把握地预测明年冬天的家庭电费，因为燃料价格、天气和政策可能迅速变化。
exp.structure: can outline...yet cannot confidently predict...构成对比；because引出近期预测困难的原因。
exp.other: outline 概述；household 家庭的；fuel price 燃料价格；shift 改变。
exp.meaning: 比较的是预测的具体程度：宽泛的远期情景有时比近期精确结果更容易描绘。不能把相对差异扩大成远期没有不确定性。
exp.rest: 近期细节难以准确预测不等于任何形式的预测或规划都无效；概述远期可能性也不等于毫无不确定性；天气和政策被明确列为影响因素。

cling-climb.q: Even after the company simplified its procedures, a few managers continued to cling to the old rules. Here, cling to means:
o: 攀爬
固守
批评
修改

exp.trans: 即使公司简化了流程，仍有少数经理继续死守旧规定。
exp.structure: Even after...是让步背景。主干：a few managers（主语）+ continued（谓语）+ to cling to the old rules（补足内容）。cling to的宾语是the old rules。
exp.other: simplify 简化；procedure 流程；continue to do 继续做；old rules 旧规定。
exp.meaning: cling to = 紧抓、依恋、不愿放弃。注意cling不是climb。
exp.rest: 攀爬对应climb，不是cling to规则的比喻；批评和修改是对规则采取改变的态度，语境却说仍不愿放弃旧规则。

causal-role-direction.target: attribute A to B / 原因与结果
causal-role-direction.q: A trial attributed a drop in workshop dust to the installation of a new air filter. Which paraphrase preserves the reported cause and effect?
o: The decrease in dust made the workshop install a new filter.
Installing the filter helped reduce the amount of dust in the workshop.
Dust in the workshop improved the filter's performance.
The trial proved that every type of pollution had disappeared.

exp.trans: 一项试验把车间粉尘的减少归因于安装了新的空气过滤器。准确改写应保留“安装过滤器 → 粉尘减少”的因果方向。
exp.structure: A trial（主语）+ attributed（谓语）+ a drop in workshop dust（宾语/结果）+ to the installation of a new air filter（原因）。attribute A to B中A是被解释的结果，B是原因；名词化的installation保留install the filter这一动作。
exp.other: trial 试验；workshop 车间；dust 粉尘；installation 安装；air filter 空气过滤器。
exp.meaning: 不要把先出现的名词误当成原因。attribute A to B的方向是B导致A，而不是A导致B。
exp.rest: The decrease in dust made...把结果倒置为安装的原因；Dust improved the filter's performance交换了受影响对象并添加无据效果；every type of pollution把粉尘减少扩大为所有污染消失。

causal-role-direction.target: 施事与受事 / 原因与结果
causal-role-direction.q: The gardeners shaded the seedlings during the hottest hours. As a result, fewer seedlings dried out. Which statement keeps the cause and the affected object in the right roles?
o: Healthier seedlings prompted the gardeners to provide shade.
The gardeners' shade reduced heat exposure for the seedlings.
The seedlings sheltered the gardeners from the hottest sun.
The drying seedlings caused a fall in the surrounding heat.

exp.trans: 园丁在最热的几小时给幼苗遮阴，因此干枯的幼苗变少了。正确改写是：园丁提供的遮阴减少了幼苗暴露在高温中的程度。
exp.structure: 第一句：The gardeners（施事/主语）+ shaded（谓语）+ the seedlings（受事/宾语）。第二句：fewer seedlings（主语）+ dried out（谓语）。As a result明确把遮阴和干枯减少连接为原因与结果。
exp.other: gardener 园丁；shade 给……遮阴；seedling 幼苗；dry out 干枯；exposure 暴露。
exp.meaning: 先标明谁采取动作、谁受影响，再核对因果方向。gardener → shade → seedlings dry out less，不能交换施事与受事。
exp.rest: 把幼苗更健康当成遮阳的先前原因是因果倒置；幼苗保护园丁交换了施事与受益者；干枯导致环境降温既反转因果，又偷换了暴露量与环境温度。

causal-role-direction.target: 因果角色 / 作用方向
causal-role-direction.q: Trust in the complaints system was weakened by delays in acknowledging reports. Fewer residents subsequently used it. Which chain matches the account?
o: Lower use caused the earlier delays, which then improved trust.
Delays weakened trust; reduced use followed that loss of trust.
Residents’ increased trust made acknowledgement take longer.
Fewer reports showed that complaints had been resolved more quickly.

exp.trans: 投诉系统迟迟不确认收到报告，削弱了人们对它的信任。随后使用它的居民减少了。符合叙述的链条是：确认延迟削弱信任，使用减少随后发生。
exp.structure: Trust是主语；was weakened是被动谓语；by delays标明导致信任下降的因素。第二句Fewer residents是主语，used是谓语，it指投诉系统。subsequently给出时间方向。
exp.other: complaints system 投诉系统；acknowledge reports 确认收到报告；delay 延迟；subsequently 随后。
exp.meaning: 被动句的语法主语是受到影响的信任，不是施加影响的延迟。第二步是后续使用减少，不能倒转为原先延迟的起因。文本是对该链条的叙述，并未报告受控实验。
exp.rest: Lower use caused the earlier delays把后续使用减少倒置为较早事件的原因，且improved trust与weakened相反；increased trust同时交换方向和变化趋势；resolved more quickly把使用量下降替换成解决速度提升，原文没有处理速度数据。

causal-role-direction.target: 原因 / 应对措施 / 后续结果
causal-role-direction.q: After several small firms missed an application deadline, the council extended the next round by a week to give them another chance. Participation in that later round has not yet been measured. Which statement preserves the roles?
o: The extension caused firms to miss the earlier deadline.
Measured gains in later participation prompted the council's extension.
Missed deadlines prompted an extension; later effects are unmeasured.
The earlier deadline was a response to the council's later extension.

exp.trans: 几家小企业错过申请截止时间后，市政委员会将下一轮的期限延长一周，给它们再一次机会。后一轮的参与情况尚未统计。错过期限是延长期限这一应对措施的背景，措施对随后参与的影响仍未知。
exp.structure: after从句：several small firms + missed + an application deadline。主句：the council + extended + the next round，by a week表示延长量，to give them another chance说明目的。Participation + has not yet been measured是现在完成时被动谓语。
exp.other: firm 企业；application 申请；deadline 截止时间；participation 参与情况。
exp.meaning: 区分原先问题、事后应对和尚未观测的效果。不能让后来的措施成为较早失败的原因，也不能凭实施措施就宣称取得改善。
exp.rest: 后来的延期不能造成更早的错过期限；尚未测量的后续参与数据不能成为先前延期的依据；较早的规则也不是对较晚措施的回应。

causal-role-direction.target: causal direction / known vs unknown outcome
causal-role-direction.skill: 区分已知原因、措施与尚未验证的后续结果
causal-role-direction.q: A grant committee extended an application deadline after several applicants missed it. The report says the effect on later participation has not been measured. Which summary is justified?
o: The missed deadline prompted an extension; later participation effects remain unmeasured.
Later participation figures prompted the committee to extend the earlier deadline.
The extension caused applicants to miss a deadline that had already passed.
Officials changed the deadline only after a separate review showed participation had fallen.

exp.trans: 几名申请者错过截止日期后，拨款委员会延长了申请期限。报告说，尚未测量这一调整对后续参与情况的影响。最准确的概括是：错过截止日期促成了延期，但延期对后续参与的影响仍未知。
exp.structure: extended是主句谓语；after several applicants missed it交代延期的时间背景和触发情境；the effect...has not been measured明确限制了对后续结果的推断。
exp.other: grant committee 拨款委员会；application deadline 申请截止日期；participation 参与；measure 测量、评估。
exp.meaning: 必须区分已知的原因与尚未测量的后果。原文支持错过期限后发生延期，但不支持断言延期一定提高或降低后续参与。
exp.rest: 后续参与数据没有促成前面的延期；延期不可能导致申请者错过一个已经过去的截止日期；原文没有提到另一次审查或参与人数下降。

paragraph-order-anaphora.q:
前一段结尾：Several departments agree that first-year students need a common research course, but they cannot agree on what the course should include.
下面哪一段最适合紧接其后？
o: One reason such a course is hard to design is that each department defines research differently.
Research courses are popular with students seeking employment in large international companies.
Departments report rising salaries among graduates who completed laboratory training last year.
The library keeps earlier course outlines that several departments submitted before the merger.

exp.trans: 前文说多个院系同意开设共同研究课程，却无法就课程内容达成一致。最自然的下一段是：这种课程之所以难设计，一个原因是各院系对“研究”的定义不同。
exp.structure: 前段核心名词是a common research course / the course。正确后段以such a course回指这个已经出现的课程，再用One reason解释前文的困难。这里such不是凭空引入新对象。
exp.other: department 院系；first-year student 大一学生；define 定义；include 包含。
exp.meaning: such a course需结合前文课程对象、无法就内容达成一致与后文原因解释来判断；有回指不等于必然紧邻，还需核对其他候选和篇章位置。
exp.rest: 研究课受欢迎、毕业生薪资和旧课程档案都与教育有关，却不解释各部门为何难以就课程内容达成一致；such a course加上原因解释同时承接前文的对象和问题。

paragraph-order-anaphora.target: this separation / 先行关系核对
paragraph-order-anaphora.q:
前一段：The warehouse stores chilled goods in one area and dry goods in another to keep them separate.
哪一句最自然地承接这一安排？
o: This separation helps staff set suitable storage conditions for each type.
These delivery dates help the warehouse decide how many drivers to hire.
Such price differences explain why customers buy smaller quantities.
The same goods sell faster in the city's larger shopping centres.

exp.trans: 前文说仓库把冷藏货物和干货分区存放。最自然的衔接是：这种分开存放也有助于员工选择合适的储存条件。
exp.structure: The warehouse + stores + chilled goods / dry goods，两个存放地点与keep them separate建立分离关系；This separation将这一安排名词化并回指，再补充它对储存条件选择的作用。
exp.other: warehouse 仓库；chilled 冷藏的；dry goods 干货；storage conditions 储存条件。
exp.meaning: this separation既有明确的分区存放关系，也解释这一安排的作用。配送日期和价格差异缺少先行对象；the same goods虽能指货物，却转去讨论销售速度，不能只因主题相似就优先。
exp.rest: 前文没有提供配送日期或价格差异，These delivery dates和Such price differences缺先行对象；销售速度只是主题相关，没有承接分区存储这一安排。

paragraph-order-anaphora.target: 段落回指 / 竞争先行项
paragraph-order-anaphora.q:
段P：The coordinators sent a draft map to the two resident representatives. The other residents received a short notice. Neither coordinator could attend the meeting.
段Q：They brought their copies of the draft map to the meeting and proposed changes.
Q中的They最合理地指谁？
o: The representatives: they received the draft map, and the coordinators were absent.
The other residents: they are the latest group mentioned before the coordinators.
The coordinators: they had sent the map, so they must have presented it.
The representatives and coordinators together: both groups worked on the plan.

exp.trans: 协调员把地图草稿发给两名居民代表，其他居民只收到简短通知；两名协调员都不能参会。下一段说他们带着各自的地图草稿参会并提出修改。They最合理地指居民代表。
exp.structure: P中The coordinators + sent + a draft map + to the representatives。The other residents + received + a notice。Neither coordinator + could attend为否定事实。Q的They + brought + their copies并与proposed并列，地图副本和参会事实共同锁定代表。
exp.other: coordinator 协调员；representative 代表；draft map 地图草稿；propose changes 提出修改。
exp.meaning: 这里不能只按最近的复数名词选先行项。要联合“谁收到地图”“谁能参会”判断；同一主题的协调员并不因此与They相同。
exp.rest: The other residents只收到notice，未建立其地图副本；The coordinators虽然发送地图，却明确不能到场，must have presented偷换了行为；两组一起参会与Neither coordinator could attend矛盾。

paragraph-order-anaphora.target: 话题相同不等于双向衔接
paragraph-order-anaphora.q:
前文：Local farmers and engineers spent three years designing a sensor that could measure soil moisture, temperature and rainfall.
【空缺】
后文：Today this linked network lets dozens of villages compare conditions in real time.
哪一句最适合填入？
o: A photo-sharing app lets farmers combine pictures and short videos into attractive posts.
They then connected the sensors to a shared network that automatically exchanged readings.
Rainfall is usually lower in the eastern villages than in the western ones.
Some local farmers prefer older methods of recording the weather.

exp.trans: 前文介绍农民和工程师共同开发传感器；正确衔接句说明他们随后把传感器接入共享网络；后文再说这个联网系统让许多村庄实时比较天气条件。
exp.structure: 前文Local farmers and engineers是复数施动者；正确句They回指这群人，the sensors回指前面的sensor，a shared network引出后文this linked network。
exp.other: soil moisture 土壤湿度；sensor 传感器；reading 测量读数；in real time 实时。
exp.meaning: 至少核对两侧：前文的人和物在候选句中有没有明确承接？候选句又是否为后文this linked network提供来源？泛泛谈某种应用的主题关联比这种双向回指弱。
exp.rest: 照片分享应用也属于农业数字技术，但没有承接开发传感器的人，也不能解释this linked network；降雨分布和传统记录方式均缺少双向承接链。

paragraph-order-anaphora.target: This is sufficient... / quantifiable antecedent / theme trap
paragraph-order-anaphora.skill: 后句This+数量必须有可计量先行内容，不能只凭problem→solution
paragraph-order-anaphora.q: The hospital board says the size of its training budget may not be the main problem. [BLANK] This is a sufficient number of hours if sessions address the most frequent errors. Which sentence best fills the blank?
o: The board urged instructors to reconsider the goals of clinical education.
Staff nurses receive six hours of simulation training each month.
The department combined several medical units into one joint task force.
Several written assessments have become more demanding this year.

exp.trans: 医院管理层认为培训预算规模可能并非主要问题。空后说：如果培训针对最常见的错误，这个小时数就是足够的。应填入护士每月接受六小时模拟训练的信息。
exp.structure: 后句This is a sufficient number of hours的This需要一个明确时长先行内容。B项six hours满足，前文budget提供主题背景，但不能只靠前文的problem寻找任何泛泛的solution。
exp.other: training budget 培训预算；simulation training 模拟训练；sufficient 足够的；reconsider 重新考虑。
exp.meaning: 原文前后双向核验：problem→solution是泛语义关联，不如This+具体数量的指代关系有约束力。正确项中的six hours与后句number of hours精确衔接。
exp.rest: 改变教育目标、合并科室、增加书面考核均未说明小时数，填入后会导致This缺少合适先行内容。

paragraph-order-anaphora.target: This proportion / measurable percentage / unrelated topic
paragraph-order-anaphora.skill: 比例指代需要数量基线，避免凭本段主题选句
paragraph-order-anaphora.q: The city wants to assess whether the space reserved for public gardens is sufficient. [BLANK] This proportion would be enough if new plots were placed near crowded neighborhoods. Which sentence fits best?
o: The city also plans to make gardeners more aware of soil safety.
Researchers expect volunteers to help with seasonal maintenance tasks and outreach.
Recent records show that one tenth of vacant lots are reserved for gardens.
Several gardens have attracted growing interest from local schools.

exp.trans: 城市想判断公共花园预留空间是否够用。空后说如果地块靠近人口密集社区，这个比例就足够。应填入‘有十分之一的空置地块预留给花园’的统计数据。
exp.structure: This proportion的先行内容必须是可作为比例的数据。C项one tenth of vacant lots提供比例；其余选项只是相关话题，没有提供所指比例。
exp.other: proportion 比例；vacant lot 空置地块；outreach 外展活动；plot 小块土地。
exp.meaning: 即使四句都围绕社区花园，只有能解释This proportion的句子才构成强衔接。不能将同一话题等同于相邻句必然连贯。
exp.rest: 土壤安全、志愿者维护、学校兴趣都与花园相关，但无法为This proportion提供数值。
